verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing says ops users can vary vesting schedules for different groups or create custom vesting (ledgy-docs-11). Tranche-level detail in financial reports (ledgy-docs-13) suggests the platform tracks vesting tranches. Beyond that, the story's specifics are unevidenced and rest on single marketing lines with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), documented automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking, in-depth docs or independent corroboration.
